defects: Missing integrability hypothesis entirely (gold requires IntegrableOn f (Ioi a)); without it the integral is a junk value of 0 when f is not integrable, making the produced statement false for non-integrable antitone nonneg f (e.g. f(x)=1/(x+1) truncated below 0)

Off-by-one/index-shift error: produced sums f(0)+...+f(N-1) (Finset.range N) whereas gold sums f(a+1)+...+f(b) (shifted by one); this makes the produced statement mathematically false in general, e.g. f(x)=e^{-x} gives sum f(0)+f(1)=1.368 > ∫_0^∞ e^{-x}dx = 1

Hypotheses strengthened from local AntitoneOn f (Icc a b) to global Antitone f, and from nonneg only on Ioi a to nonneg on all of ℝ — narrows the class of functions covered, not equivalent to gold's more general local hypotheses

Loses generality of arbitrary starting point a : ℕ (gold's lemma holds for any a, b); produced statement only fixes the ray/sum start at 0, so it is a strictly less general (and, due to the index shift, actually incorrect) special case
